hinweis_intern: Source for site/assets/glossar/abstimmung.json (built by werkzeug/glossar_seite.py). Public text: never name modern translators (owner, 09.11.2026). Counts: zaehle.py, word forms, period spellings folded. vorschlag = current proposal or null where the drafts disagree.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's central term for the stages of nature and of God; Hegel takes it over in his Jena writings, where he is still close to Schelling. In mathematics it is the exponent.

optionen.hinweis: Standard in Schelling scholarship; mathematical exponents stay "power".
One word for everything, including the mathematics; collides with Macht and Kraft.
Archaic; keeps the term visibly technical.

entscheidungen.frage: Mensch is not Mann. How should the translation render the human being in texts written around 1800?

optionen.hinweis: Keeps Mensch and Mann apart; "man" only for Mann.
Period-faithful in tone, as older translations do; ambiguous today.
Flexible, but the search can no longer rely on one word.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's first principle, which Schelling and Hegel discuss constantly. (Counts include the ordinary pronoun ich.)

optionen.hinweis: Literal, now the usual rendering in Fichte and Hegel scholarship.
Readable, but merges das Ich with das Selbst.

entscheidungen.frage: Fichte's counterpart to the I. Should it follow whatever is chosen for das Ich?

optionen.en: ethical life in Hegel, morality in Kant and Fichte
optionen.hinweis: Deliberate divergence by sense; the German word stays visible in the reader.

optionen.hinweis: By sense; freie Willkür = free choice.

entscheidungen.frage: Kant's readers know "end" (kingdom of ends); Hegel's readers know "purpose" (purposiveness, external purpose).

optionen.en: purpose (fixed phrases keep "end": final end, end in itself)
optionen.hinweis: One word per lemma; the Kantian formulas stay recognizable.

optionen.en: end in Kant-dependent texts, purpose in Hegel and Schelling
optionen.hinweis: Faithful to each tradition, harder for the search.

entscheidungen.frage: No English equivalent: it is the seat of feeling and of cognition at once.

optionen.hinweis: Literal; keeps "the existent" free for das Existierende.

optionen.hinweis: "absolute knowing" in both Fichte and Hegel.

optionen.hinweis: Reads more naturally as a subject.

entscheidungen.frage: Kant's third category of relation; for Hegel the last category of the logic of essence. Our drafts disagree here.

optionen.hinweis: Usual in the translations of Hegel's logic.

entscheidungen.frage: Three words, all near "limit". Hegel plays Grenze against Schranke, Kant distinguishes them, Fichte builds on Beschränkung. Our drafts disagree here. (Count: Grenze.)

optionen.hinweis: Grenze = limit, Schranke = limitation, Beschränkung = restriction.
Schranke = restriction, so that "limitation" stays with Beschränkung.
Loses the kinship between Grenze and "limit".

entscheidungen.frage: Religious faith, but also epistemic belief (Jacobi's Glaube, Fichte's Vocation of Man).

optionen.hinweis: By sense; the German word stays visible.

entscheidungen.frage: English has one word, body. Fichte's Leib (my articulated body) is not a Körper (a physical body). (Count: Leib.)

optionen.en: body for both, "physical body" for Körper where contrasted
optionen.hinweis: The German word stays visible in the reader.

entscheidungen.frage: Exposition of a system (Darstellung meines Systems), but also presentation in art, and Kant's exhibition of a concept.

optionen.hinweis: Default; "exhibition" only in Kant's technical sense.

entscheidungen.frage: Herr is God (der Herr), the feudal lord, the master of a servant, and Mr. in address. Schelling's God is Herr des Seyns.

optionen.en: by sense: the Lord (God), lord, master, Mr.
optionen.hinweis: Herr des Seyns = Lord of being.

entscheidungen.frage: Schelling's original doubleness of nature. In English "duplicity" also means deceit.

optionen.hinweis: Keeps the term unique; needs a note.

entscheidungen.frage: The name of Fichte's philosophy. Translate it or keep it?
Fichte's coinage for the I's self-positing: an act that is at the same time its own product. He coined it against Tatsache (fact).

optionen.hinweis: Keeps the play on fact/act; unusual typography.

entscheidungen.frage: What the I runs up against: at once an obstruction and an impulse. Outside the Wissenschaftslehre an everyday word.

optionen.hinweis: Established in Fichte scholarship; needs a note on the double sense.

entscheidungen.frage: The imagination "schwebt" between opposites (1794); in the late Wissenschaftslehre knowing "schwebt" over itself.
"Das Ich setzt sich schlechthin." Machine translation renders it "absolutely" and so merges it with absolut.
In the late Wissenschaftslehre faktisch is opposed to genetisch: what is simply found, not derived.
The I's own activity. Fichte also uses Spontaneität.

entscheidungen.deutsch: Volk / Nation (Reden an die deutsche Nation)
entscheidungen.frage: Fichte uses both words, and not as synonyms. Both are politically loaded in English.

optionen.hinweis: Marks the German concept; strong overtones.

entscheidungen.frage: In the late Fichte everything is image: Bild, Bilden, Bildsein. Never to be confused with Bildung.

optionen.hinweis: Clearer, but loses the verb as a term.

entscheidungen.deutsch: das Soll, das Durch, das Dass, das Was
entscheidungen.frage: The late Fichte turns small words into nouns: das Soll, das Durch, das Von. English has no natural way to do this.

optionen.en: capacity to be; that which can be / must be / ought to be

entscheidungen.frage: The being that precedes all thinking, which thought can never get ahead of. In ordinary use "immemorial".

entscheidungen.frage: In the Freedom essay, what comes before ground and existence. Schelling builds a series: Grund, Urgrund, Ungrund, Abgrund.

optionen.hinweis: Looks backward, which Sehnsucht here does not.

entscheidungen.frage: Identity philosophy: the absolute forms the infinite into the finite (Ineinsbildung). Schelling reads Einbildungskraft this way. (Count: Ineinsbildung and Einbildung together.)

optionen.hinweis: Literal; keeps the play with imagination.

optionen.hinweis: A fixed pair; antitype is rare.

optionen.hinweis: Three words; a note on the Greek sense.

entscheidungen.frage: The blind rotating drive of the forces before creation (Ages of the World). Contains Trieb (drive).

optionen.hinweis: Marks the strangeness of the term.
